scope: SQLite durable-friendly snapshots, checkpoints, events, audit, outbox, replay and lease fencing
invariants: raw and canonical state snapshots carry a digest and corruption fails closed
events are contiguous per run and duplicate identity/digest conflicts are rejected
event and outbox rows commit transactionally
replay detects missing sequence and can converge from a durable snapshot
audit rows are append-only and protected by database triggers
expired worker leases fence stale snapshot/checkpoint writes

verification.focused_and_regression_command: pytest tests/test_p3_persistence_events.py tests/test_job_store.py tests/test_persist.py tests/test_p2_hitl_state.py tests/test_p1_canonical_model.py tests/test_p0_contract_baseline.py -q --basetemp ..\tmp\ai2-p3-independent

limitations: SQLite primitives do not prove production HA or external exactly-once side effects
worker scheduler/queue integration is not implemented in P3
production retention and RTO/RPO remain P9 decisions
